title: ‘God Does Not Like Ugly’ — A Call for Nigerian Pastors and Brethren to Rise Up
summary: Pastor Daniel Whyte III calls upon Nigerian pastors and brethren to rise up against the persecution of Christians.
body_html:
Pastor Daniel Whyte III shared this word during his October 9 sermon, 'Prayer, Love, and Advice for the 144,000 Homeless People in Atlanta.' Watch the full sermon here: facebook.com/reel/1723799432046158.

“God does not like ugly, and so I'm calling upon our Nigerian pastors and brethren to rise up.”

— Daniel Whyte III

Watch the full sermon: facebook.com/reel/1723799432046158
takeaway: “Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.” (Isaiah 60:1, KJV)
